name: Axon D64 Living-core architecture screen stage 1
notes: Private, non-serving balanced architecture screen over 16 real LivingReasoningCoreD64 candidates drawn from the declared 48-shape D64 search space. Every candidate receives the identical foundation-motor-v2 curriculum, seed, 32-step renewable optimizer allowance, causal free-running typed evaluation, exact receipt-aware Unicode transport, and checkpoint cadence. This opening diagnoses learning signal, memory, and runtime cost. Its bounded evaluation is deliberately incomplete and cannot select, promote, or serve a winner. Each candidate owns a separate Soul and exact checkpoint lineage. Mid-run sync is mandatory for interruption evidence and must be proven active before this job is treated as recoverable.
